Hello Professor Alvarez — this is sarah-agent, Sarah's assistant. Sarah would like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week (Nov 23–27). Could you tell me a slot that suits you? Some windows that are free on her side:

- Monday: 10:00-10:30, 14:00-14:30
- Tuesday: 13:40-14:10? (busy CSE452 13:40-15:00) — better: 15:00-15:30? (CSE455 office hours 15:30) — Tuesday free: 13:40 blocked; 15:00–15:30 free
- Wednesday: 10:00-10:30, 16:20-17:00 (only 40 min free at end)
- Thursday: 12:00-12:30? (lunch booked) — Thursday free: 10:50-12:00 block and 14:10... ; Thursday 12:50 onwards free
- Friday: 12:20-12:50? busy Advisor 1:1 12:20-13:20

Simplest: Monday 10:00-10:30 or Wednesday 10:00-10:30. Let me know what works and I'll confirm to Sarah.

On it — I've written to Professor Alvarez (`alvarez-agent`) asking for a 30-minute slot next week (Nov 23–27) and offering a few windows that are free in your schedule. I'll book it in CALENDAR.md and confirm to you as soon as he answers.
Thanks, that sounds good. Please let me know as soon as he picks a slot, and put it in my calendar once he confirms.
Will do — as soon as he picks a slot I'll add the 1:1 to CALENDAR.md (with a log line) and tell you right away.
Hello — alvarez-agent here, covering Professor Alvarez's calendar. Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30 works: booked and logged. I'll ping you if anything comes up.

Hello — alvarez-agent here, I look after Professor Alvarez's calendar. I'm filling in next week (Nov 23–27) and want to check against the official schedule: are there lectures, seminars or university meetings that week that you've changed or added, especially anything on Monday 10:00–10:30? Thanks.

Hello. Nothing has been cancelled, moved or added next week (Nov 23–27): the official schedule stands as published.

Monday 10:00–10:30 is free of university events — the Curriculum committee ends at 10:00 and the next scheduled item is the Colloquium at 13:00.

I can confirm scheduled lectures, seminars and university meetings; private appointments are not mine to know or share.
Thank you — noted, nothing changes on my side then. I'll come back to you if anything needs checking.
Thanks! Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30 it is — noted on Sarah's side. Ping me if anything changes.
Booked ✅ Professor Alvarez confirmed **Monday Nov 23, 10:00–10:30** for your 30-minute 1:1. It's in `CALENDAR.md` (Monday) with a `BOOKED` line in the log.
Great, that fits — Monday 10:00–10:30 is free. Thanks for sorting it out.
